title: Paginated Data Table
prompt:
You are a web developer. Complete the following task.

TASK: Build a React functional component called `DataTable` that takes a prop `data` (array of objects with `id`, `name`, `email`, `role`) and `pageSize` (number, default 5). Render a table with columns Name, Email, Role. Implement pagination with "Previous" and "Next" buttons and a "Page X of Y" display. Add column header sorting so clicking a column header sorts by that column and toggles ascending or descending. The currently sorted column header should show ▲ or ▼. Previous is disabled on page 1 and Next is disabled on the last page.

CONSTRAINTS:
- Functional component with `useState`
- Default export
- Props: `data` (array), `pageSize` (number, default 5)
- Table with Name, Email, Role columns
- Pagination: Previous/Next buttons + "Page X of Y"
- Column sorting: click header to sort asc/desc
- Show ▲ or ▼ on the sorted column
- Disable Previous on page 1, Next on last page

IMPORTANT:
- Return ONLY the code. No explanations.
- Output a single complete file.
- Do not use markdown code blocks.
